scope: Independent read-only reconciliation of accepted source identities, explicit lexical counts, two audited environment inventories, and selected source references. No Lean compilation or mathematical proof review was performed in this count audit.

counting_conventions.explicit_theorem_lemma: The predecessor publication count convention: remove block comments using /\-.*?\-/ with DOTALL, remove line comments, and count the exact multiline regular expression below. Includes explicitly declared private lemmas/theorems; excludes definitions, generated helpers and informal examples. Import roots contribute zero. This is a lexical count, not a theorem-inventory metric.
counting_conventions.exported_declarations: Union of the two accepted Lean environment inventories. Includes generated helper declarations, definitions and theorems. Count is not a claim of 5,321 distinct mathematical theorems.

controls.scope: Two separate accepted verification records. Neither set was replayed by this publication count audit; do not describe their sum as a fresh 52-control replay.
